reviews.comment:
la atención en el Full es pésima, la oferta muy limitada de opciones para el almuerzo llegando al medio día y en vacaciones. La atención es mala, y demoran un montón. la atención en la playa de combustibes tbn deja mucho que desear. Nos paso lo mismo hace unos meses pero pensamos que era algo aislado, definitivamente no y no volveremos a probar. Si pueden vallan directamente a la YPF de Catriel que está a unos pocos km más y es superior en atención, limpieza y oferta, mil veces mejor.

(Translated by Google)
The service at the Full is terrible, the lunch options are very limited, especially during peak times and holidays. The service is bad, and they take forever. The service at the gas station also leaves much to be desired. We had the same experience a few months ago, but we thought it was an isolated incident; it definitely wasn't, and we won't be going back. If you can, go directly to the YPF in Catriel, which is a few kilometers further away and is far superior in service, cleanliness, and selection—a thousand times better.
